page: Microsoft Azure DC48ads_v6 is a virtual machine instance from the DCadsv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This server features an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture, delivering 48 dedicated virtual CPUs. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

For local storage requirements, the instance includes 1843 GB of local disk capacity. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or graphics processing units, focusing its hardware profile entirely on CPU-driven and memory-intensive workloads.

The dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer predictable performance for enterprise applications. The inclusion of substantial local storage alongside Premium Storage compatibility makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring a balance of compute power, memory, and fast local disk access. Suitable workloads include relational databases, enterprise application servers, and general-purpose business applications that require dedicated processing resources without GPU acceleration.
description: The Microsoft Azure DC48ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine from the DCadsv6 family, powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. With its dedicated CPU allocation and substantial local storage, the DC48ads_v6 is designed for workloads requiring consistent compute performance and reliable disk access. It is well-suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, database hosting, and mid-tier application servers.
